text:
Type: grey and white patterned cushion
Use: on a sofa, an armchair or a bed; living room, bedroom
Style: Scandinavian, traditional, farmhouse
Materials: smooth cotton fabric with a printed pattern, flat flanged border
Colors: medium grey, white
Shape: square cushion with a dense symmetrical folk ornament of flowers and leaves in vertical bands, narrow flat flange around the edges, soft and full
Feel: cozy, crisp, homey, classic
Goes with: white or grey sofas, light wood, black or grey textiles; Scandinavian, farmhouse or cottage rooms

product.name: KERKULLA
product.description: You can easily vary the look because the two sides have different designs.
